method: Inference-time evidence augmentation using the existing frozen E2 sequence-classification checkpoint; no additional training or fine-tuning.

model.reuse_constraint: E3 and E4 use this identical checkpoint and inference configuration. The E2 checkpoint and E2 result remain unchanged.

input.construction: facts extract followed by selected verbatim evidence passages in selection order, separated by two newline characters
input.windowing: full-coverage overlapping windows using the corrected E2 construction rule

inference.threshold_note: Not applicable: the frozen E2 primary rule is two-class argmax over mean logits, not scalar thresholding.

evaluation.population: existing frozen 30-case answer-key-covered ILDC test subset
